Actions.Name: Dial: Exposure
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust Exposure over OSC (-3 … 3). Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: Dial: Ambient
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust Ambient over OSC (0 … 1). Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: Dial: Bloom
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust Bloom over OSC (0 … 2). Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: Dial: White Balance
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust White Balance over OSC (2500 … 10000). Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: Dial: Fill
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust Fill over OSC (0 … 2). Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: Dial: Hue Clamp
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust Hue Clamp over OSC (0 … 1). Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: Dial: Contrast
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust Contrast over OSC (0 … 1). Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: Dial: Saturation
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust Saturation over OSC (0 … 1). Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: Dial: Flare
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust Flare over OSC (0 … 2). Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: Dial: Flare Size
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust Flare Size over OSC (0 … 2). Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: Dial: Flare Angle
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust Flare Angle over OSC (0 … 180). Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: Dial: Flare Streaks
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust Flare Streaks over OSC (1 … 7). Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: Toggle: Auto Exposure
Actions.Tooltip: Toggles Auto Exposure over OSC.

Actions.Name: Toggle: Laser Flicker
Actions.Tooltip: Toggles Laser Flicker over OSC.

Actions.Name: Capture Command
Actions.Tooltip: Fires any Capture menu command (View, Edit, File…). Dims when the command is disabled.

Actions.Name: Capture Tab
Actions.Tooltip: Switches Capture to Design, Fixtures, Universes, Media, Snapshots or Library.

Actions.Name: Camera Slot
Actions.Tooltip: Recalls Camera Position 1–5. While a Store Modifier key is held, stores it instead.

Actions.Name: Store Modifier
Actions.Tooltip: Hold this key, then press a Camera Slot to store the camera there.

Actions.Name: Show Position
Actions.Tooltip: Recalls a camera position from the open show over OSC, titled with its name in Capture.

Actions.Name: View Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust a Capture view setting over OSC. Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset.

Actions.Name: View Toggle
Actions.Tooltip: Toggles Auto Exposure or Laser Flicker Effect over OSC.

Actions.Name: Connection
Actions.Tooltip: Shows whether Capture answers over OSC, its version, and whether Accessibility access is OK. Press to re-check.

Description: An interface to Capture: keys fire Capture's own menu commands and tabs and recall camera positions; dials adjust view settings over OSC.
